name: Acknowledging God
overview: Acknowledging God begins with recognizing Him as the Creator of all things, as declared in Genesis where God brings the heavens, earth, and light into existence. Scripture shows that God sovereignly grants the earth to humanity, underscoring His authority and provision. True acknowledgment involves seeking God with understanding and trusting in Him wholeheartedly rather than relying on human wisdom, reflecting a heart posture of dependence and reverence toward the LORD.
